title: Bengal Unfolded
tagline: History is still unfolding in our present
intro: Explore connected chapters from 1757 to 2024 to trace how power, language, resistance, and democratic demands shaped Bengal and Bangladesh.
timelineSubheading: Move across linked moments and see how each transition created the conditions for the next.
whyJourneyMattersBody: These chapters are not isolated episodes. Together, they explain how memory, institutions, and civic action continue to shape rights, identity, and public life.
